note: Full-service marina + RV park at 1533 CR 309, Georgetown, near Marker 72 on the St. Johns River at the NE corner of Lake George. RV sites have cable TV and a concrete patio; also 7 cabins. Boat launch, fuel, pump-out, bait/tackle store; guide service and airboat charters.
summary: Operator site: confirmed $50/night (tax and electric included), 33 full-hookup sites with 20/30/50-amp, water and sewer, showers/laundry/store; added Wi-Fi hot spots. Fees year changed 2026 -> 2025 (the rates page is undated, last modified Aug 2025). Not stated: booking method beyond an information-request form, season, max rig length. Note: dropped the old $45/$225/$450 prices (now $50/$250/$500) and hookup restatements.
flags: Price gate: $50 a night INCLUDING tax and electric (before tax it is under $50, but the page states no tax rate). Rates page undated (HTTP Last-Modified 2025-08-06). The family has not stayed here.
